result.title: CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Pretrained generative policies provide strong behavior priors for robot control, but adapting them efficiently with online reinforcement learning remains difficult. A central challenge is how to improve a frozen generative policy without destroying the structure learned from offline demonstrations. Noise-space residual methods address this by modifying the policy's input noise, but existing noise-space methods typically regulate adaptation through fixed latent feasible regions, which may exclude valuable noise edits. In contrast, action-space residual methods are more sample-efficient, but their efficiency can still be further improved. We propose Conservative Noise Directional Optimization (CNDO), a noise-space residual RL method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning state- and noise-conditioned directions around Gaussian latent samples. CNDO removes predefined latent feasible regions and instead regulates noise-space adaptation through the soft conservative constraint, which consists of conservative value estimation and gated execution. We further introduce Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization (CANDO), which adds an action-space residual, combining structured latent-space improvement with local action correction. Experiments show that, once CNDO narrows the gap between noise-space and action-space residual learning, CANDO further improves over single-space optimization, achieving 76.1 NAUC and a 91.4% final success rate, surpassing the best single-space results by 6.6 NAUC and 4.1% success rate. More demos and info are available on https://cando-rl.github.io/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CNDO 与 CANDO：在不破坏预训练生成策略的前提下，于高斯噪声空间学习以状态和噪声为条件的改进方向，用保守价值估计与门控执行替代预设可行域，再叠加动作空间残差以提升机器人控制中的在线适应效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 对冻结生成器做「latent 方向编辑＋门控执行」的做法，可能为 LVR 中推理期 latent 干预的方向学习与是否生效的停止/门控决策提供可核查线索；但任务为机器人控制，迁移性需自行判断。
